composition.serve_who: This sheet ("230V AFT DISTRIBUTION PANEL", GMMS 108'-102a) is a distribution schedule for the 230V AC AFT panel: three earth-leakage-protected incoming feeds (AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2) feed two banks of numbered breakers (Q1-Q6, Q17 on the left; Q7-Q16 on the right), each named row a load supplied via one dedicated breaker. Every named load is its own served equipment/system; the panel itself (earth-leakage devices, incoming feeds, bus/rail structure) is shared infrastructure belonging to the AFT distribution panel, not to any one load. Register match: this is a distinct AFT panel — not the same node as 694-main-ac-panel (Main AC Panel), so panel-identity facts stay local to this sheet; individual galley/outlet loads map to their equipment nodes per the engineer-confirmed mapping table.

infrastructure.system_name: 230V AFT Distribution Panel (incoming feeds, earth-leakage protection, breaker rails)
facts: Three incoming 230V feeds: AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2 — each shown with a 16 (wire-gauge diamond callout, x2 per feed) and its own earth-leakage device (Earth Leakage 1 for AFT OUTLETS, Earth Leakage 2 for GALLEY 1, Earth Leakage 3 for GALLEY 2).

Left breaker bank Q1-Q6 (+ isolated Q17) fed from the GALLEY-side incoming runs; right breaker bank Q7-Q16 fed from a combination of the AFT OUTLETS and GALLEY 1 runs per common-rail nets net4/net5 (Q7,Q8,Q9) and net6/net7 (Q10,Q15,Q16,Q17).
Q15 and Q16 (16A each) are spare/unlabelled breaker ways (shown as '/' with no load name) — spares for future installation, not uncertainties.

No node exists in the register specifically for 'AFT distribution panel' as a physical enclosure distinct from 694-main-ac-panel; panel bus/incoming-feed topology recorded here as infrastructure without a target node until such a node is confirmed.
